gotchas: susubayi_dict has NO _meta column -- the harness prompt asks for an _meta stamp on dict inserts that cannot be written.
kemasan == packsize on 3376/3430 rows; both are the human-readable pack string e.g. '800 gr'.
gramasi_abbott spells out multipacks as '130 gr x 2 pcs' while kemasan/packsize carry the TOTAL ('260 gr').
keyword_typo is '' (never NULL) when there is no alias; it is the leading token block of keywords.
parent_brand falls back to brand when parent_brand is null/empty -- resolve that fallback before feeding the leaf value in, the pattern's `sources` list takes the column name literally.

susubayi_dict has ~70 flat attribute columns beyond the generated ones (segment_*, category_*, mji_* fields etc). When minting a new row, copy the full row of the closest sibling SKU (same brand+sub_brand, adjacent gramasi or adjacent stage) and only change the fields that genuinely differ (gramasi/kemasan/packsize/gramasi_abbott/size_single/tonase, and sku/sku_complete/sku_type_abbott/sku_type_complete/keywords derived from them, plus stage/usia/usia_atas/usia_bawah/subvarc_abbott/new_stage_mji when the stage differs). Never invent unrelated attribute values.
